sources_quoted.text: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.
Unmake — Nearby enemy champions take 12% more magic damage.

{{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.

Abilities with {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effects have their cooldown reduced equivalent to {{as|20 ability haste}}. (Imperial Mandate in the current cache has NO damage proc at all — 'pair_damage' cannot be a Mandate Coup-de-Grace ally proc.)

{"name": "Abyssal Mask", "stale": false, "stat_drift": {}} / {"name": "Imperial Mandate", "stale": false, "stat_drift": {}} — the cached 12% and 7% constants are current, so neither value is a stale-constant fix.

the mitigation operator `x -> x*100/(100+R)` is *linear in raw damage* for a fixed resistance — so a multiplicative damage-taken amplifier commutes with mitigation and shows up as an exact scalar factor on the post-mitigation leaf.

sources_quoted.source: data/items.json — exhaustive scan of every passive/active branch for a '12% increased/more/amplified damage' effect
sources_quoted.text: Only Abyssal Mask matches for magic damage (Spear of Shojin = ability-damage stacks, Immortal Path = 12% healing, Prowler's Claw = 12% max-health damage). data/runes.json contains no 12% amp. The changed factor is therefore uniquely attributable to Abyssal Mask's Unmake curse.

step_1_factor_extraction.note: Both leaves are printed to 1 decimal. new * 1.12 = 252.672 -> 252.7 (matches old exactly); old / 1.12 = 225.625 -> 225.6 (matches new exactly). The delta between the two candidate values is EXACTLY one application of a 1.12 multiplier and nothing else.

independent_computation.step_2_attribution: 1.12 is Abyssal Mask 'Unmake' (12% increased magic damage). It is not Imperial Mandate 'Command' (1.07), not the two composed multiplicatively (1.07*1.12 = 1.1984), and not the two composed additively (1.19). new*1.07 = 241.4 and new*1.1984 = 270.4, neither of which is the old value. So the change under test is precisely 'the Unmake curse is / is not applied to this event', with the Mandate Vulnerable amp and all mitigation math untouched.

step_3_rule_from_cached_wiki_text.unmake_scope: The cached wiki text restricts Unmake on THREE axes: (a) damage type — '12% increased MAGIC damage' (riotDescription: '12% more magic damage'); (b) target type — 'Enemy CHAMPIONS ... become cursed'; (c) source — 'from all sources', i.e. once cursed, ANY attacker's magic damage is amplified, and the curse is a single debuff on the target, not a per-attacker buff.
step_3_rule_from_cached_wiki_text.command_scope: Imperial Mandate's Vulnerable is deliberately broader — 'increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%' with no damage-type qualifier. The ONLY textual difference between the two amps in this scenario is Abyssal's magic-damage-type restriction. A 'mandate_abyssal_curse_roster' scenario exists to pin exactly that asymmetry.

step_4_candidate_explanations_for_the_1..hypothesis: H-A (type gate): event[11] is physical or true damage; the old build amplified it by the magic-only curse. Fix restricts Unmake to magic damage.
step_4_candidate_explanations_for_the_1..wiki_support: '12% increased MAGIC damage' — explicit type restriction.

step_4_candidate_explanations_for_the_1..hypothesis: H-B (target gate): event[11]'s defender is not an enemy champion (pet/summon/non-champion), so the curse never applied.
H-C (double-application): two roster holders (or holder + self) each applied the curse; old = base*1.2544, new = base*1.12. 1.2544/1.12 = 1.12, matching the observed factor exactly.
step_4_candidate_explanations_for_the_1..wiki_support: The curse is a debuff ON the target ('become cursed ... from all sources'), i.e. a single unique state, not a per-source stacking amp.

step_4_candidate_explanations_for_the_1..hypothesis: H-D (regression): event[11] is genuine magic damage against a cursed enemy champion, and the change wrongly stopped ally-held auras from amplifying a teammate's damage.
step_4_candidate_explanations_for_the_1..wiki_support: 'from all sources' — an ally-held Abyssal Mask must amplify the whole team's magic damage.

independent_computation.step_5_discrimination: H-D is the only hypothesis under which the old value wins, and it is the weakest fit. (1) If cross-participant (ally-held) amp plumbing had broken, Imperial Mandate's Vulnerable — also an ally-held, roster-sourced damage-taken amp — would have dropped out of the same event too, giving a 1.1984 or 1.07-flavoured factor; the observed factor is a clean, isolated 1.12, i.e. the Mandate half of the very same roster machinery still lands. (2) A 1.12-only delta is the exact signature of narrowing Unmake to the scope its own cached text states (magic damage, enemy champions, one curse per target), which is a correction, not a loss. (3) Both candidate values are consistent with the cached 12% constant, so the constant itself is not in dispute and 'both_wrong' is excluded: any wrong-constant fix would have produced a factor other than 1.12.

step_6_reconstructed_value.arithmetic: correct = old / 1.12 = 252.7 / 1.12 = 225.625 -> 225.6 (1 dp). Equivalently, if Mandate's Vulnerable is live on this event, the un-amplified pair damage is 225.625 / 1.07 = 210.84, and the correct leaf is 210.84 * 1.07 = 225.6, with NO * 1.12 curse factor because Unmake's cached text does not reach this event's damage type/target.
step_6_reconstructed_value.note_on_mitigation: Per docs/math-foundations.md §1.2, mitigation x -> x*100/(100+R) is linear in raw damage, so the amplifier is an exact scalar on the post-mitigation leaf; no mitigation re-derivation is needed to test the factor.

limitations: The golden scenario definition for 'mandate_abyssal_curse_roster' lives in scripts/ (golden_snapshot.py) and the baseline in scripts/golden_baseline.json — both out of bounds for this oracle, and neither the roster composition nor event[11]'s damage type appears anywhere under data/ or docs/math-foundations.md (grep for 'pair_damage' and 'mandate_abyssal' over the export returns nothing).

The absolute pre-amp base damage therefore cannot be rebuilt from first principles here; what IS independently verifiable from the cached wiki text is (a) the changed factor is exactly and only Abyssal Mask's 12% Unmake curse, (b) the cached constants 12% and 7% are current and unchanged, and (c) the curse's own text restricts it to magic damage on enemy champions as a single target-side debuff.

Residual risk: if event[11] is in fact magic damage dealt to a cursed enemy champion by a roster member AND the Vulnerable window happened not to cover this event, hypothesis H-D would also produce a clean 1.12 factor. Confirming the verdict to certainty requires event[11]'s damage_type and defender identity from the golden ledger, which this oracle is not permitted to read.
conclusion: The delta is exactly one application of Abyssal Mask's 12% Unmake curse. The cached wiki text restricts that curse to magic damage received by enemy champions, applied once as a target-side debuff; three of the four ways to produce this exact factor are corrections of an over-broad application, and the one regression story is contradicted by Imperial Mandate's 7% roster amp still landing on the same event. The lower value is the one the cached source text supports.
